conventions.PPI: BLS Producer Price Index news release, 08:30 America/New_York
conventions.ISM_SERVICES: ISM Services (until mid-2020 'Non-Manufacturing') Report On Business, 10:00 America/New_York as printed on the PR Newswire release
conventions.G17: Federal Reserve Board G.17 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization monthly release, 09:15 America/New_York; standalone annual-revision publications are not entries (see log)
conventions.API_WSB: API Weekly Statistical Bulletin, dates from API's published annual schedules, 16:30 America/New_York (standing 'approximately 4:30 pm Eastern')
conventions.CROP_PROGRESS: USDA NASS national Crop Progress (weekly, April-November; 2019 ran into December), time as printed on the NASS calendar (16:00, once 17:00)
conventions.TREASURY_AUCTION: every nominal coupon Note/Bond auction (2-, 3-, 5-, 7-, 10-, 20-, 30-year original term, reopenings included) with announcemt_date < auction_date; instant = closing_time_comp (ET); TIPS and FRNs out (members' EC-AUC filter: floating_rate "No", inflation_index_security "No")
conventions.dates: the date actually published; moved releases carry the published date
conventions.collisions: one entry per release instant; same-instant entries are separate (listed under same_instant_entries)
